projects.title: Collections analytics & automation
projects.when: December 2016 – September 2025 (Analyst I → Analyst III, Collection Intelligence/Contribution Recovery)
projects.summary: Power BI dashboards, SQL data pipelines (DB2, BigQuery), Excel/VBA and Power Automate workflows for collections analytics at Sura Peru.
projects.problem: Each debt report took ~30 minutes to produce, the late-payment rate was 27%, and the panel of 5 external collection providers I supervised included redundant ones.
projects.built: Power BI dashboards, SQL data pipelines (DB2, BigQuery), Excel/VBA and Power Automate workflows.

results.label: late-payment rate
results.text: Lowered the late-payment rate from 27% to 24% by pairing the scoring model with targeted campaigns.

results.label: lower operating costs
results.text: Cut operating costs ~40% by using scoring and performance data to consolidate the redundant external providers I supervised (from a panel of 5).

results.label: per debt report
results.text: Cut debt-report generation from ~30 minutes to ~2 minutes per report with Excel VBA and Access macros, enabling batch generation.

results.label: less manual processing
results.text: Reduced manual processing ~45% across the team by building automations and standardized, parameter-driven reports (including self-service report tools for the legal team).

projects.title: WhatsApp demand-signal pipeline
projects.summary: Turning Latin American community group chats into structured demand signals for small retailers in Ontario.
projects.problem: Small retailers serving Latin American communities in Ontario guess what to stock; demand is visible in community group chats but unstructured.
projects.built: A locale-aware parser (`wa_parse.py`) that handles Spanish-locale Android WhatsApp exports and their encoding quirks; now adding structured LLM extraction per message (product, category, brand, intent, urgency) with the Anthropic API.

results.text: Parser built and validated; extraction stage in progress.
